title: Product Designer
description:
Please note this position is a fixed term maternity cover contract from 01.07.2026 till 01.09.2027.




👩 💻👨 💻 About the role

Only four years after entering the market, Mondu is one of Europe’s leading B2B payments providers. Now live across 30+ markets, trusted by ambitious companies, and operating with an EMI license, we’re expanding our commercial footprint in Europe and beyond.




To support our Product Management efforts, we are now looking for a Product Designer who lives at the intersection of high-end design aesthetics and technical innovation. The ideal candidate will own the end-to-end journey of specific product domains - from deep-dive discovery and user research, to high-fidelity prototyping and developer handoff. You will work in a cross-functional team alongside Product, Sales, Strategy and Engineering, to turn complex regulatory requirements into elegant, effortless experiences.




🚧 What you’ll do

 * End-to-End Ownership: As the sole designer, manage the entire design process: mapping user journeys, wireframing, creating seamless workflows, and building interactive prototypes in Figma across our suite of data-heavy products and solutions.
 * Engineering Collaboration & Design QA: Work closely with the engineering team from final hand-off through development. You will perform thorough Design QA to ensure all shipped features match your designs and maintain a high standard of quality.
 * Data-Informed Iteration: Partner directly with the Product Team to review A/B test results, usage data, and session recordings (e.g., PostHog/Metabase) to identify friction points and iterate on live features and possible improvements.
 * Marketing & Brand Support: Assist the Marketing team by creating digital visuals and marketing materials, ensuring Mondu’s brand remains cohesive and impactful across all touchpoints.
 * Stakeholder Collaboration: Work directly with cross-functional stakeholders, presenting your concepts and advocating for design choices using clear, data-driven logic.
 * Design for Trust: Create intuitive onboarding and verification flows that simplify "Know Your Customer" (KYC) processes while maintaining transparency and security.
 * Evolve the Design System: Maintain and update our shared component library in Figma, ensuring a cohesive visual language across our products and platforms.
 * Champion Accessibility: Ensure all designs comply with WCAG guidelines and EAA (European Accessibility Act) standards, making our financial products accessible to everyone.
 * AI-Driven Workflows: Look for opportunities to integrate AI tools into your design lifecycle, optimizing your solo workflow for tasks like generating assets or accelerating layout testing.




🏅What you need to succeed

 * Experience: 5+ years of professional experience as a Product Designer, ideally within FinTech, B2B SaaS, or a similarly complex regulated industry.
 * Design Mindset: You understand that "simple" is hard. You have a track record of taking complex financial workflows and making them scannable and actionable.
 * Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Figma (variables, auto-layout, and advanced prototyping). Familiarity with AI-assisted design tools is a plus.
 * Strategic Thinking: You don’t just take orders; you ask "why." You can articulate the business impact of your design decisions to stakeholders.
 * Communication: Excellent English communication skills.
 * Start-up vibe: Experience working at speed, building the plane while already flying.




✨It would be a plus if you also:

 * Have experience with Adobe Creative Suite (especially Illustrator and Photoshop) to further support visual and marketing requests.
 * Prior experience not just using, but actively building, scaling, or managing comprehensive design systems.




🎁 What's in it for you?

 * € 1000 per year for you to contribute to your learning & development to help you grow professionally and personally.
 * €300 per year for you to endorse team build, including dinners, games, and events.
 * 28 vacation days per year (increasing 1 day every year up to 30).
 * We welcome you to our office in the center of Berlin 3+ days a week.
 * Take advantage of our Workation policy, allowing for up to 6 weeks every year of work outside of Germany (some restrictions apply).
 * Subsidised gym membership to boost your physical and mental well-being.
 * € 46 per month towards the DeutschlandTicket.
 * Tax relief for payments into our Business Bike scheme.
 * You can accelerate your career and take ownership of your work and development in a flat hierarchy where 360 feedback is encouraged.




🦸 Are you a Monduneer in disguise?

Working in a truly diverse group makes us stronger and more resilient. Furthermore, it enables an unfair advantage - the opportunity to learn from each other, see different perspectives, and consider a broader range of variables in our decision-making. That is what being a Monduneer is all about.




Thus, regardless of your background, age, disability, gender, parental status, race, religion, sexual orientation, educational background, or any other aspect you feel is a statement of your diversity, we look forward to discussing your role in mind.




If you believe you are a Monduneer in disguise, and it's time for you to shine, submit your application, and we'll take it from there.




💜 Meet Mondu

Mondu is changing the B2B payments ecosystem by providing payment solutions that enable any B2B company to grow quickly and safely. We envision a future where businesses, not just consumers, experience a seamless, modern, and human-centered payment flow. Founded by a dream team of passionate entrepreneurs and seasoned tech leaders, Mondu is rapidly scaling. In just four years, we've secured over $120 million in funding, attained an e-money banking license through the Dutch National Bank, and assembled a talented team of over 100 Monduneers across our three locations of Berlin, Amsterdam and London. On the road, we have successfully launched numerous products accessible to buyers in +30 markets - and counting!




Our products bring B2B payments up to par with B2C payments: putting the people behind the business at the heart of the payment flow, and ensuring they have a seamless, modern and state-of-the-art experience, whether they are sellers or buyers.




We’re building a culture at Mondu where amazing people do their best work. If you’re ready to grow your career and help thousands of organizations pay better, you’re in the right place.

title: Product Manager (m/w/d)
description:
🫵 Mach etwas, worauf du stolz bist. Wenn du komplexe Softwareeinführungen souverän steuerst und Lust hast, etwas aufzubauen, das die Sozialwirtschaft spürbar entlastet – dann bist du bei Parto genau richtig.


Parto ist die digitale All-in-one-Zahlungslösung für Sozial- und Pflegeeinrichtungen. Wir digitalisieren Bargeld- und Zahlungsprozesse in der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, Eingliederungshilfe und Altenhilfe – einfach, sicher und vollständig digital.


Mit Parto VISA Karten und unserer Softwareplattform können Mitarbeitende sämtliche Ausgaben für Klient:innen sowie für die tägliche Leistungserbringung effizient abwickeln. Dadurch reduzieren wir Verwaltungsaufwand, vermeiden Medienbrüche und entlasten insbesondere pädagogische Teams, Verwaltung und Finanzbuchhaltung nachhaltig.


Die Pflege- und Betreuungsmärkte wachsen stark: Bis 2055 wird die Zahl der betreuten Menschen voraussichtlich um 30 % steigen. Gleichzeitig fehlen bereits heute Fachkräfte – bis 2030 werden allein in der Pflege rund 300.000 zusätzliche Mitarbeitende benötigt.


Unsere Mission: Wir helfen Einrichtungen dabei, zeitaufwändige Prozesse rund um Verwahr-, Klienten- und Etatgelder zu digitalisieren und zu automatisieren – damit mehr Zeit für Menschen bleibt.


Aufgaben


Als Product Manager bei Parto gestaltest du aktiv die Zukunft unserer Plattform und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team digitale Finanzlösungen für die Sozialwirtschaft weiter. Dabei arbeitest du an Produkten, die reale Probleme lösen und täglich von tausenden Mitarbeitenden in Pflege- und Betreuungseinrichtungen genutzt werden.


Du übernimmst Verantwortung für zentrale Teile unserer Produktentwicklung – von der ersten Idee bis zum erfolgreichen Launch. Gemeinsam mit unserem Product- & Engineering Squad sorgst du dafür, dass wir die richtigen Probleme lösen und Produkte mit echtem Mehrwert entwickeln.


Dabei übernimmst du unter anderem folgende Aufgaben:


   
   
 * Du definierst klare Produktanforderungen auf Basis von Nutzerfeedback, Kundengesprächen, Daten und Business-Zielen.

 * Du sprichst regelmäßig mit Kund:innen, um ihre Herausforderungen und Bedürfnisse tief zu verstehen.

Die Rolle bietet dir viel Gestaltungsspielraum und echtes Wachstums-Potenzial: Was du heute als Produkt entscheidest und aufbaust, wird entscheidend dafür sein, wie tausende Mitarbeitende in der Sozialwirtschaft künftig arbeiten.


Qualifikation


Du bist eine analytische und gleichzeitig pragmatische Produktpersönlichkeit mit hoher Eigenverantwortung. Du möchtest Produkte entwickeln, die echten Nutzen stiften, arbeitest gerne eng mit technischen Teams zusammen und fühlst dich in schnell wachsenden Startup-Umfeldern wohl.


Du verstehst es, Nutzerbedürfnisse, technische Möglichkeiten und Business-Ziele zusammenzubringen und daraus klare Prioritäten abzuleiten. Dabei denkst du strategisch, arbeitest hands-on und übernimmst Verantwortung von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung.


Must-haves


   
   
 * Mehrjährige Erfahrung (idealerweise 3+ Jahre) als Product Manager im SaaS-, FinTech- oder ERP-Umfeld
   
   
 * Englischkentnisse in Wort und Schrift (Company Language)
   
   
 * Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise
   
   
 * Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen in klare Produktentscheidungen und Prioritäten zu übersetzen
   
   
 * Hohe Ownership und Hands-on-Mentalität – du bringst Themen eigenständig voran
   
   
 * Freude an enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern
   
   
 * Technisches Grundverständnis – du musst nicht programmieren können, solltest aber APIs, Schnittstellen und technische Zusammenhänge verstehen
   
   
 * Erfahrung in schnelllebigen Startup- oder Scale-up-Umfeldern
   
   


Nice-to-haves

 * Erfahrung mit ERP-Integrationen oder komplexen B2B-Softwarelösungen
   
   
 * Verständnis für Prozesse in der Sozialwirtschaft, Pflege oder im Gesundheitswesen
   
   


Benefits


Du arbeitest mit einem der talentiertesten FinTech-Teams Deutschlands daran, eine völlig neue Kategorie von Softwarelösungen für die Sozialwirtschaft aufzubauen – und damit dringend notwendige Veränderungen in Pflege, Betreuung und Verwaltung aktiv mitzugestalten.


Dabei stehen deine persönliche Entwicklung, Eigenverantwortung und Entfaltung für uns an erster Stelle. Wir schaffen eine ambitionierte, empathische und unterstützende Kultur, in der du wachsen, wirken und gemeinsam mit uns erfolgreich sein kannst.


   
   
 * Standort Hamburg – unser Headquarter befindet sich im Herzen von Hamburg
   
   
 * Freie Wahl deiner Hardware – MacBook, Setup & Equipment nach deinen Bedürfnissen
   
   
 * Workation-Möglichkeit – arbeite zeitweise von dort, wo du dich wohlfühlst
   
   
 * 30+ Urlaubstage – für echte Erholung und Zeit außerhalb der Arbeit
   
   
 * Faire Vergütung plus virtuelle Unternehmensanteile (VSOP) – partizipiere direkt am langfristigen Erfolg von Parto
   
   
 * Steuerfreie Benefits – zusätzlich zu deinem Gehalt erhältst du eine HelloBonnie Benefit-Mastercard mit monatlich 50 €, z. B. für Sport, Mobilität oder andere persönliche Benefits
   
   
 * Regelmäßige Team-Offsites & Events in Europa – gemeinsam arbeiten, reisen und als Team wachsen
   
   
 * Internationales, ambitioniertes Team – arbeite mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen aus ganz Europa zusammen
   
   
 * Greenfield-Umfeld – wir gestalten eine völlig neue Produktkategorie von Grund auf
   
   
 * Starke Investoren & Netzwerk – unterstützt von renommierten VCs und erfahrenen Business Angels
   
   
 * Viel Gestaltungsspielraum & echter Impact – was du aufbaust, beeinflusst direkt, wie hunderte Einrichtungen künftig arbeiten werden
   
   


Klingt nach dir?


Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.


Bei Parto hast du die Möglichkeit, in einem hochmotivierten Team echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen, sichtbaren Impact zu schaffen und eine Branche mitzugestalten, die gesellschaftlich wichtiger kaum sein könnte – wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Principal Product Designer
description:
Principal Product Designer




tracebloc · Hybrid · Full-time







About tracebloc




tracebloc is a federated learning workspace. Users train, fine-tune, and benchmark ML models on private data that never leaves their infrastructure (hospitals, banks, factories). We orchestrate training across distributed runs the contributor never sees, average model weights across them, and return a single working model.




Our users are ML engineers and data scientists. The product is technically dense and the UX is the moat.







The role




You'll be the first dedicated product designer at tracebloc. The whole experience is yours: from how a contributor links their dataset, to how a researcher reads a benchmark, to how a model gets queued, trained, averaged, and shipped.




Today the product works. It's also fragmented. Different surfaces were built at different times by engineers without a design partner. Your year-one mandate is to make tracebloc feel like one product.

You report directly to Lukas (founder, CEO) and work with the engineering team. No design team to hand off to. No design manager above you.







What you'll own




 * Research with ML engineers and customers (mostly remote, occasional travel)
 * Information architecture across the workspace, the SDK docs experience, and the contributor flow
 * Prototyping (Figma is fine, code is better)
 * Visual and interaction design across web and the SDK touch points
 * The design system, until we hire your second designer
 * Hiring the next designer when the time comes







You




 * 5 to 9 years shipping product design at technical products. Dev tools, ML platforms, data infrastructure. Your users were engineers, not consumers.
 * Strong systems thinker. You can hold the whole product in your head and decide what shipping order makes sense.
 * Comfortable building from research, not just polishing handed-down briefs.
 * Tight visual craft. We're not asking you to be a brand designer, but every screen ships under your hand.
 * You'd rather have a 30-minute call with a customer than a 30-minute design review.







Bonus




 * Prior founding-designer or principal experience at an early-stage technical product
 * Worked on ML, federated learning, or privacy-preserving ML
 * Comfortable shipping in code (React, Tailwind, Next.js)
 * Published writing or talks on technical product design







How to apply




Email carrer@tracebloc.io with:

 1. Portfolio or LinkedIn
 2. One shipped project where the user was technical. One paragraph on the hardest UX decision you made on it
 3. Earliest possible start

 * I read every email myself. Expect a reply within 5 days.

title: Product Manager (m/w/d)
description:
baue nicht nur Produkte, sondern die Strukturen dahinter


Du suchst keine Rolle, in der du Backlogs verwaltest und Roadmaps pflegst, die andere längst entschieden haben?


Gut. Denn hier geht es nicht um Verwaltung - sondern um Professionalisierung.


Wir suchen einen Product Manager (Mid–Senior), der hands-on am Produkt arbeitet: Discovery selbst durchführt, mit Kunden spricht, Business Cases kalkuliert, Anforderungen schreibt und die Umsetzung mit der IT begleitet. Jemanden, der nicht auf perfekte Prozesse wartet, sondern sie selbst mitgestaltet.


Wer wir sind & wo wir stehen


Wir sind eine junge Unternehmensgruppe (30+ Personen) an der Schnittstelle von Legal, Legal Tech und Tech. Unter unserem Dach arbeiten eine etablierte B2B-SaaS-Plattform im Legaltech-Bereich, eine eigenständige Kanzlei, ein Datenschutz-Consulting und eine neu gegründete IT-GmbH.


Unsere Plattform gibt es schon eine ganze Weile. Sie gliedert sich in einen kostenlosen Bereich und einen Premium-Bereich und umfasst zahlreiche Generatoren und Features, die historisch gewachsen sind und aktuell Schritt für Schritt erneuert und optimiert werden. Wir haben funktionierende Produkte, eine breite zahlende Nutzerbasis und laufende Projekte.


Was noch fehlt: ein professionalisiertes, zahlenbasiertes Produktvorgehen, eine klare Produktstrategie, die gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung getragen wird, und ein sauber aufgebauter Product-Tribe. Es gibt Substanz - aber noch kein professionalisiertes System. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du steigst nicht in eine bestehende Produktorganisation ein, du baust sie mit auf - und bleibst dabei hands-on am Produkt. Dein Impact wird direkt sichtbar: in Produkten, Prozessen und Zahlen.


Aufgaben

   
   
 * Product Discovery durchführen: Kundengespräche, Research, Validierung von Ideen - unterstützt durch gängige KI-Tools
   
   
 * Business Cases kalkulieren und bewerten
   
   
 * Anforderungen strukturiert schreiben (Requirements, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria)
   
   
 * Rapid Prototyping mit KI-Tools, um Ideen schnell visualisierbar und testbar zu machen
   
   
 * Umsetzung gemeinsam mit interner und externer IT begleiten
   
   
 * Weiterentwicklung und Umsetzung der bestehenden Product Roadmap
   
   
 * Alle neuen Features und Optimierungen konsequent auf KPIs ausrichten
   
   
 * Professionalisierung des Produktzahlenwerks in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem bereits bestehenden BI-Team (Basis an Zahlen ist vorhanden, das Framework muss geschärft werden)
   
   
 * Enge Verzahnung mit dem Marketing-Team, das über Automatisierung und E-Mail-Kampagnen kontinuierlich Leads generiert
   
   
 * Unterstützung der Geschäftsführung bei der Erarbeitung einer übergreifenden Produktstrategie
   
   
 * Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung eines funktionierenden Product-Tribes
   
   
 * Identifikation, Bewertung und Umsetzung neuer Produkt- und Business-Cases
   
   


Qualifikation

   
   
 * Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Product Management (Mid–Senior Level) mit B2B-SaaS-Produkten (wir sind rein B2B), idealerweise mit historisch gewachsenen Plattformen
   
   
 * Hands-on Mindset: Du führst Discovery selbst durch, sprichst mit Kunden, schreibst Anforderungen und bleibst bis in die Umsetzung dran
   
   
 * Routinierter Einsatz gängiger KI-Tools in der Produktarbeit - von Discovery-Unterstützung bis Rapid Prototyping

title: Product Manager (Solar)
description:
Company

Founded in Berlin, autarc is a ~40 person start-up who were part of Y Combinator’s S24 batch in San Francisco. Our team consists of people in Sales, Tech and Operations, with the Engineering & Product department currently ~20 people, as we continue to grow throughout the year.

Role Description

We're looking for a Product Manager to work in one of our key product teams in building the leading OS for Europe's solar workforce.

You'll participate in customer visits for product discovery, help shape and maintain our product roadmap, run planning sessions and sprint preps with team leads, manage tickets in Linear and open Cursor to ship stuff yourself.

We're experiencing growth in new territories and whilst there is a GTM launch underway, each specific market has their own requirements that will effect the way our software is designed and built.

Other responsibilities will be as follows:


 * Support leadership in shaping and prioritising the product roadmap
 * Run product discovery alongside our teams through direct customer engagement
 * Manage product operations in Linear: triage, prioritisation, sprint hygiene
 * Build and ship features or prototypes directly using AI-assisted development tools (Lovable, Figma, Cursor, Copilot)
 * Facilitate planning sessions with product teams and sprint preps with engineering leads
 * Represent autarc in customer calls, sales meetings, and training sessions
 * Work alongside our Engineers in building and shipping material
   
   

This is a Product Manager position but as the landscape of the industry shifts, we also expect you to build and tangibly contribute on a day-to-day basis.

Requirements


 * 2-5+ years of experience as a Product Manager
 * Exposure to working in B2B SaaS
 * AI-native in working with tools to help you run faster and jump higher
 * Track record in conducting user interviews and product discovery
 * A desired obsession to go deep into Solar, PV and the renewables space altogether
 * Berlin-based and willing to work hybrid
 * German native a very nice to have (or bilingual with French, Spanish, Italian, Polish etc.)
   
   

What We Offer


 * Freedom to choose your own equipment (within a budget)
 * 26 paid vacation days
 * An annual team retreat
 * The choice between Dance or JobRad for mobility
 * The choice between Classpass or Urban Sports Club for fitness
 * Regular team events, lunches and activities
   
   

Next steps

If your application is successful, you will participate in the following:


 * Screening call with Louis (Recruiter)
 * Culture fit call with a Product Manager
 * Take home case study/exercise
 * Final on-site interview with Marius (CTO) and the team
   
   

About Us

Right now, 25% of CO2 emissions in Europe are caused by heating our buildings. In order for this to be reduced, the transition towards renewable energy needs to be simplified and made more accessible. There are too few installers to meet the growing demand for heat pumps, and a solution to match this trend needs to be brought to the market.

autarc is developing the leading operating system (OS) for heat pump installers, enabling a more digital and efficient installation process for heat pumps.

Through this, autarc is reducing the hurdles to decarbonizing single-family homes and small apartment buildings in Europe, with the goal to help with the planning and designing of 1 million heat pumps by 2030.

title: Product Manager (m/w/d)

title: Senior Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Hey, You! Nice to meet you!

As the leading platform for non-professional football in Europe, we bring professional experiences — from news and data to gamification — directly to a community of over 190 million footballers and fans.

We are Prematch, founded in 2021 in Cologne — a dynamic startup with a smart and ambitious team. Our marketing and business teams are based in Cologne, Berlin, and London, while our tech and product teams work remotely across Europe.

We’re backed by strong partners such as adidas, Krombacher, NIVEA MEN, and Techniker Krankenkasse — with a couple of exciting collaborations still in the pipeline. Successful investors like Ralf Reichert (CEO of ESL) and Verena Pausder are supporting us on our journey.

Already a good match if you....


 * want to work 2-3 days from our office in Berlin or Cologne, and don't just want to work 100% remotely
 * know the product management game - this role won’t be new to you
 * bring experience with social or mobile products
 * have a passion for football or team sports
   
   

… That fits already? Then you should read on.

Main information


 * Top office in Cologne/Berlin + option to work remotely up to 3 days a week
 * Start: Immediately (flexible start)
 * Scope: full time
 * Area of Responsibility: Product
 * Quick, easy & transparent application process
   
   

For this we need you

We're looking for someone to take ownership of our platform's growth – both operationally and strategically. In this role, you'll coordinate and inspire a cross-functional team to ship high-quality features at pace, while driving continuous product discovery to keep us moving fast. Your focus will be on taking the platform to the next level: deeper usage, stronger interaction, and growing network effects – all while ensuring high execution standards and tight alignment across the organisation.

Your mission


 * Product Processes: Continuously improve how we work as a product team
 * Product Roadmap: Define and execute the product roadmap in close alignment with business goals
 * Cross-functional Collaboration: Ensure effective communication and collaboration between engineers, designers, and other departments
 * Product Discovery: Drive discovery and user research efforts for both existing and new features
 * Performance & Insights: Monitor and analyse product performance, user feedback, and market trends to inform decisions
 * Visibility: Create transparency and alignment across the team on priorities, progress, and outcomes
 * Troubleshooting: Support the team in identifying and resolving product-related issues
 * Analytics & Dashboards: Maintain product analytics and performance dashboards to track key metrics
 * Experimentation: Define and oversee A/B tests to drive continuous feature improvements
   
   

What Do You Need


 * Experience: 5+ years in product management, including 1+ years in a leading role (leading IC or management)
 * Football: Familiarity with grassroots football
 * Track Record: Experience shipping successful products, preferably mobile applications
 * Communication: Exceptional communicator with the ability to motivate and inspire others – especially in stressful phases
 * Adaptability: Comfortable thriving in a fast-paced startup environment
 * Organisation: Strong organisational and multitasking abilities
 * Hands-on Mindset: Willingness to roll up your sleeves and stay hands-on when needed
 * Analytics & Data Tools: e.g. Amplitude or similar
 * Collaboration Tools: e.g. GitLab or similar
 * Design Tools: e.g. Figma or similar
 * Research Tools: e.g. Typeform, Useberry or similar
 * Languages: Fluent in German & English
   
   

Advantage but not a must


 * Experience with social networks and growth strategies
 * Technical background or understanding of mobile app development
   
   

Why us?


 * Be part of it from the start – Shape how Prematch grows and transforms amateur football.
 * Competitive salary that you can be proud of.
 * Employee participation (VSOP) — directly benefit from the company’s success.
 * Three cool offices in Cologne, Berlin, and London — true startup vibes to work and grow together. Want to visit another office? We support that too!
 * Homeoffice — depending on your distance to the office, you work 1–3 days a week onsite and the rest flexibly remote (working from home at the start and end of the week is quite popular) — whatever suits you best. Tech & Product roles sometimes offer 100% remote.
 * Remote, even from afar — Whether it’s a week of sunshine abroad or a few days with family — we allow flexible work from outside your usual location.
 * Team spirit — whether in the office or at home, we use cool tools and a virtual office to keep the team tightly connected.
 * Modern IT equipment — We provide the tools and devices you need to be productive.
 * 27 vacation days per year — For your rest and to recharge. Plus special arrangements if you’re a parent, so you can better balance family and relaxation.
 * Team events at our locations — Whether after work in Cologne, Berlin, or London: we regularly bring teams together to connect and grow stronger.
 * Offsites with the whole team — Four days out of the daily grind with the entire team: trips, brainstorming, onsite collaboration, and real team spirit.
   
   

Right up your alley?

Then let's not waste any time!

All we need is your current CV (we like it easy!) You can easily submit more information about yourself in our short application form. Lisa will then get in touch with you. We are all very relaxed - so feel free to start directly with the "you"!

We can't wait to learn more about you!

title: (Senior) Product Manager | Carbmee
description:
Intro

We're building the infrastructure for corporate carbon management, and we're looking for a (Senior) Product Manager to help shape it. You'll own product modules end-to-end, work directly with enterprise customers, and operate at the intersection of complex technical problems and real business impact. This is a role for someone who moves fast, makes decisions with incomplete information, and genuinely enjoys the messiness of building in a scale-up.

Your tasks


 * Own the full lifecycle of your product modules: from discovery through delivery and iteration
 * Work closely with engineering, design, and commercial teams to ship products enterprise customers actually use
 * Engage directly with customers to understand their needs and translate them into sharp product decisions
 * Drive sales enablement and support go-to-market for your modules where needed
 * Use AI tools and modern workflows to move faster and build smarter
 * Travel to customers 1-2 times per quarter
   
   

Your profile


 * Proven product management experience in a B2B software environment: ideally a scale-up with enterprise customers
 * Technical background (Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent): you can hold your own in architecture discussions and dig into the details
 * AI-savvy: you use AI tools in your day-to-day work and understand where they create leverage
 * Self-directed and decisive: you don't wait for strategy to be handed to you
 * Strong communicator and stakeholder manager, comfortable with both customers and internal teams
 * High ownership and drive: you care about outcomes, not just output
   
   

Nice to have: experience with data (SQL, dashboards, integrations), UI/UX sensibility, or product marketing / sales support exposure.

You'll thrive here if you're energized by ambiguity, move fast, and want real ownership over what you build: not just a seat at the table.

Benefits

Benefits


 * Unique & Powerful Mission: join a fast-growing and ambitious tech company that is shaping the future of carbon management and fighting climate change
 * Compensation & Rewards: a steep learning curve and ownership from day one. We offer an attractive compensation package, including virtual stock options
 * Health & Wellbeing: Urban Sports Club subscription to stay healthy & fit.1:1 coaching sessions with Nilohealth for your mental well-being.
 * Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: a flexible hybrid working culture with a lovely accessible office in Berlin-Mitte or the center of Munich
 * Team Culture: Our transparency, Humility, and Accountability values create a unique and supportive working environment. Be part of a multinational, motivated team that thinks work should be fun!
 * Connection & Networking: Summer Offsite, Winter Party, and regular team events We give you plenty of opportunities to connect with people, strengthen cross-functional relationships, and boost collaboration
 * Trust & Transparency: monthly All-Hands Meetings, weekly update newsletters, and Founders Q&As. We keep you informed on current company numbers and goals
   
   

About Carbmee

carbmee is on a mission to help the world's most emissions-intensive industries (automotive, manufacturing, logistics, chemicals) get carbon reduction under management. Our patented Environmental Intelligence System, carbmee EIS™, gives enterprises like Maersk, Miele, and Coca-Cola the precision carbon data they need to reduce cost, risk, and carbon at scale.

Founded in Berlin in 2021, we closed a €20M Series A in December 2024 and are growing fast. This is the moment to join.

About Us

carbmee is an Enterprise Software company built for the architectural backbone of the global economy. In an era where sustainability defines a company’s right to operate, we provide the System of Action for the world’s most complex manufacturing sectors with a strong footprint in Automotive and Defense.

We specialize in high-stakes, large-scale enterprise deployments where environmental data is no longer just a reporting requirement, but a critical strategic asset. Our platform empowers global industry leaders to transform fragmented data points into actionable intelligence, enabling them to make the defining decisions for the future of their products and supply chains.

At the heart of carbmee is a team of world-class talent: a powerhouse of engineers, industry experts, and visionaries dedicated to solving the most pressing industrial challenges of our time. We believe that solving the "hard-to-abate" problem requires the best minds in the world, and we are constantly looking for exceptional individuals to join our mission. We are calling this the "Industry Endgame".

Backed by a €20M Series A from top-tier investors and operating out of our hubs in Berlin and Munich, we are scaling rapidly, having the ambition to build a generational software company out of Germany.

title: Senior Product Analyst (all genders)
description:
Responsibilities


At Aroundhome, we are dedicated to making data the foundation of our product strategy and business decisions. To drive this further, we are building up a department of Product Analytics to tackle the most challenging tasks from the business and user side, improve processes and tools, and drive data excellence across the organization.


As a Senior Product Analyst, you will be at the forefront of transforming data into valuable insights, helping our domain teams make informed, data-driven decisions before building new features.


   
   
 * Enable Data-Informed Decisions: Perform analyses that address specific business needs, allowing teams to make timely and informed decisions. Advocate for the use of data in everyday decision-making processes
   
   
 * Define and Track KPIs: Act as an advisor on KPI definitions and data requirements, working directly with stakeholders to establish metrics that align with business goals and accurately reflect product performance
   
   
 * Build and Optimize Dashboards: Ensure visibility of key metrics and performance indicators, by developing and maintaining reports and dashboards in Tableau/Metabase.
   
   
 * Shape Scalable and Trusted Data Foundations: Partner with Product and Engineering to define data models, uphold data governance and curate analytics-ready datasets that are reliable, scalable and designed to enable self-service analytics across the organization
   
   
 * Empower Teams Through Data: Enable product teams to effectively leverage data and analytics tools by fostering data literacy, supporting self-service analytics, and guiding evidence-based decision making across the organization
   
   
 * Provide Strategic Insights: Conduct in-depth analyses, providing thorough, actionable insights for complex projects that shape strategic decisions
   
   
 * Contribute to Product Development: Bring a strong focus on product analytics, working closely with domain teams to proactively share insights, validate product ideas, and challenge assumptions with quantitative evidence
   
   
 * Collaborate with the Data Engineering team to ensure data quality, accessibility, and seamless integration of data sources, supporting efficient analytics and reporting processes
   
   


Skills

   
   
 * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent in a relevant field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science)
   
   
 * Proven experience (3+ years) in a product analytics role, preferably in a B2C or marketplace environment, partnering closely with product managers and engineering teams to guide feature development
   
   
 * Hands-on experience accompanying the full product development lifecycle — from discovery and ideation to rollout, experimentation, and post-launch analysis
   
   
 * Strong understanding of Product Analytics, including user behavior analysis, and proven ability to independently design, set up, and evaluate experiments (A/B tests) with a good understanding of statistical methods/analysis and experimentation logic
   
   
 * Proficiency in data analysis tools and languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, etc.) as well as data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Metabase, etc.)
   
   
 * Understanding of data infrastructure, data governance, and data engineering concepts
   
   
 * Experience supporting self-service analytics initiatives and empowering cross-functional teams with data access
   
   
 * Strong communication skills and ability to translate data insights into actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
   
   


What we offer


Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. If you are not based in Berlin, we appreciate it if you’re generally open to coming to our office occasionally - for example, for team days, workshops, or important meetings. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.


Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer monthly Tech Talks, an annual training budget, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.


Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner “Fürstenberg Institute” is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.


Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness for environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.


Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.

 * Feedback Call

title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
description:
Warum es die Rolle gibt


Als Head of Product schließt Du die Lücke zwischen operativer und strategischer Produktentwicklung und leitest und mentorst das Product Owner Team. Mit Markt‑ und Kundenverständnis, unternehmerischem Denken und klaren Insights entlastest Du das C‑Level und treibst die Strategie von endios voran.


Das erwartet Dich bei uns

   
   
 * Du verantwortest die end‑to‑end Produktentwicklung – von der Idee über die technische Umsetzung bis hin zur Markteinführung.
   
   
 * Du entwickelst die Produktvision zusammen mit Deinem Team weiter und richtest sie konsequent an den Unternehmenszielen aus.
   
   
 * Du setzt die strategische Roadmap um, sorgst für termingerechte, qualitativ hochwertige Releases und gewährleistest höchste Performance.
   
   
 * Du leitest, mentorst und entwickelst Dein Team und etablierst klare Rollen, Entscheidungsprozesse und Arbeitsweisen.
   
   
 * Du beobachtest Markt‑ und Technologietrends sowie Entwicklungen im KI‑Umfeld und leitest daraus proaktive Innovationen und Optimierungen für unsere Produktstrategie ab.
   
   
 * Du integrierst Künstliche Intelligenz gezielt in Produkte und Entwicklungsprozesse.
   
   
 * Du analysierst und optimierst die komplette Customer Journey – vom ersten Kontakt über Nutzung und Support bis zur langfristigen Bindung.
   
   
 * Du führst deutschsprachige Kundeninteraktionen, berätst und unterstützt unsere Kunden.
   
   
 * Du etablierst skalierbare Prozesse, die das Produkt wachsen lassen – ohne Agilität oder Qualität zu verlieren.
   
   
 * Du bist Verantwortlicher für das interne und externe Stakeholder‑Management und koordinierst die Schnittstellen zu IT, Design, Customer Service, Marketing und Vertrieb, um ein einheitliches Nutzer‑Erlebnis sicherzustellen.
   
   


Das bringst Du mit

   
   
 * Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Führungserfahrung in einem SaaS-Umfeld im Bereich Energy, Mobility oder einer vergleichbaren Branche mit.
   
   
 * Du begeisterst Dich dafür Dein Team kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, zu coachen und individuelle potentiale auszubauen und gemeinsam Projekte zum Abschluss zu bringen.
   
   
 * Du denkst unternehmerisch und verstehst end-to-end Geschäftsprozesse.
   
   
 * Du hast eine hohe KI‑Affinität und Erfahrung mit KI‑basierter Produktentwicklung.
   
   
 * Du bist kommunikationsstark, präsentierst überzeugend und kannst auf allen Ebenen Stakeholder begeistern (inkl. C-Level Management).
   
   
 * Du bringst eine hohe Entscheidungsstärke und Durchsetzungsvermögen mit.
   
   
 * Du bist versiert im Umgang mit agilen Methoden und kennst die Prozesse des Produkt‑Lifecycle‑Managements.
   
   
 * Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch und bist bereit, mindestens 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Hamburger Büro zu arbeiten.
   
   


Warum endios

   
   
 * Du hast die Möglichkeit, Dich in einem wachsenden Unternehmen in einer dynamischen Branche frei zu entfalten, die Zukunft mitzugestalten und Dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
   
   
 * Du übernimmst von ersten Tag an Verantwortung und nutzt unsere kurzen, schnellen Entscheidung um aktiv mitzugestalten.
   
   
 * Du bist Teil einer lebendigen Kultur, in der das "Wir" zählt. Ob im modernen Hamburger Office oder bei unseren regelmäßigen Team-Events – bei uns findest Du Kollegen, die Lust haben, gemeinsam etwas zu bewegen und dabei den Spaß nicht zu kurz kommen lassen.
   
   
 * Du arbeitest flexibel und selbstbestimmt. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, 30 Tagen Urlaub und der freien Wahl zwischen Remote und Office gibst Du Deinem Leben den Takt vor.
   
   
 * Du profitierst von einem Paket, das Deine Leistung wertschätzt. Neben einer wettbewerbsfähigen Vergütung bieten wir Dir Benefits, die zählen und vor allem ein Umfeld, in dem Du Dich langfristig wohlfühlst und weiterentwickeln kannst.

title: Senior Product Manager - Matching Platform (all genders)
description:

Aroundhome is a two-sided marketplace platform where the possibility of shared success begins with the match: the moment a homeowner is connected with the right partner. The Matching Experience domain owns this critical step of the marketplace journey: making you responsible for transforming house owner service requests into high-quality partner matches that lead to successful projects and long-term platform engagement. At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping the success of Germany’s leading housing project platform. We work in a domain-based model, where each product team owns a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration within cross-functional teams and ensures that the expertise needed for continuous product discovery, hypothesis development, and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.


As a Senior Product Manager, you play a critical role in driving and executing the strategy, setting a clear direction, and ensuring that your domain delivers meaningful value to both customer groups - homeowners and partners - as well as to the business.

Skills

title: Product Intern (m/f/d)
description:
Help Build Agentic AI for Insurance — Join inca as an Intern (Product)


We’re hiring a Product Intern to support the CPTO of inca for the next 3-6 months and help bring our Agentic AI vision to life. You’ll be at the core of defining, designing, and deploying cutting-edge AI agents that automate complex insurance claims.


This is not a “watch-and-learn” internship. You’ll be working directly on core product topics — from AI agent definition to testing data preparation and service design. Expect a high-speed, high-responsibility environment where your work will ship.


Who We Are


We are inca - a venture-backed startup on a mission to automate insurance claims through Agentic AI.


   
   
 * 🚀 We bring Agentic AI to insurance industry with a no-bullshit approach — delivering cutting-edge results, where others overpromise.
   
   
 * 🔥 The market is on fire: we’re flooded with inbound interest from insurers eager to transform their claims processes.
   
   
 * 🧠 Our team combines former BCG Project Leaders, industry- and AI-experts. Together, we’re redefining how insurances are operating in Europe.
   
   
 * 💥 We're backed by top-tier VCs from one of the most competitive InsurTech Pre-Seed rounds in Europe
   
   


Tasks


You’ll work side-by-side with inca’s CPTO and engineering team to accelerate the development of our product engine. Your tasks will include:


   
   
 * 🧪 Conduct product interviews with internal experts and users to define capabilities and workflows for AI agents
   
   
 * 🧰 Prepare testing data and test scenarios to evaluate AI agent performance
   
   
 * 🤝 Collaborate with senior engineers to design the services and tools that bring these agents to life
   
   
 * 🧠 Derive data-driven insights to drive product decisions
   
   
 * 🧭 Support the CPTO in crafting and maintaining the product roadmap
   
   
 * 📝 Assist in creating documentation, flows, and UX outlines for the agentic engine
   
   


Requirements


What You Bring


   
   
 * 🎓 You’re currently studying or have completed a degree in product, tech, or business
   
   
 * 📦 3+ internships or working student experience in product management, product design, or AI/tech startups
   
   
 * 💡 You think in systems and data — how parts interact, how users behave, and what makes things work well - and how we find the traces in data
   
   
 * ✍️ You’re structured and curious, communicate clearly, and love getting to the root of complex problems
   
   
 * 🧪 Bonus: Familiarity with agent-based systems, AI model evaluation, or test automation
   
   
 * 🛡️ Bonus: Experience or understanding of insurance or P&C claims is highly valuable
   
   


Benefits


Why INCA


   
   
 * 🤖 Real AI, real impact. We don’t do AI theater. We build agentic systems that actually work — transforming an industry that’s been asleep for decades.
   
   
 * 💥 No-bullshit culture. No politics, no empty promises — just clarity, ownership, and results.
   
   
 * 🧠 Elite learning curve. Work side-by-side with former BCG Product Leaders and AI experts. Learn how to build and scale a venture-backed startup from the inside.
   
   
 * 🌍 Location. Based in Berlin (3+ days per week on-site), hybrid-friendly, with regular offsites and founder exposure.
   
   
 * 🌴 Timing. Start ASAP for a 3–6 month full-time internship with a competitive salary.
   
   
 * ⚡ High-speed environment. We move fast, fix fast, and execute relentlessly — because we’re here to win.
   
   
 * 🏋️‍♀️ Plus: all the perks you’d expect — and the momentum of building something that actually matters.

title: Junior Product Manager Merchandise (m/w/d)
description:

title: Product Owner
description:
Product Owner (German & English speaking) (M/F/D)




Are you a highly motivated and dedicated Product Owner who thrives on taking complete ownership of a digital product? Have you successfully managed the entire product development lifecycle, from ideation and strategy to development, launch and maintenance? Are you passionate about continuous learning and data-centric improvement considering user and stakeholder feedback? Do you inspire your team and your stakeholders with your vision and product plan? Do you have a track record of navigating your team’s way to success through complex market, resource and stakeholder setups? If this description resonates with you, then YOU are exactly who we are looking for!




That's What It's About:




 * Build and maintain a sustainable relationship with your stakeholders and represent MobiLab in the best way possible.
 * Conduct effective stakeholder and user workshops to collect and analyze diverse information and assess the potential for offering MobiLab’s products and services.
 * Learn the depth of customer requirements and translate them into tailored software solutions that solve real problems.
 * Research, design, improve, and optimize the user journeys of your product.
 * Establish and prioritize your product backlog, considering both business and user value.
 * Test ideas and enhance solutions based on metrics and user feedback.
 * Take full responsibility for your product and coordinate your team to deliver results with the highest quality.
 * Have the high-level as well as the low-level view of your product and its status at all times and streamline your stakeholder communications accordingly.
 * Contribute to improving MobiLab’s product ownership processes through active exchange and knowledge transfer with your peers.




This Is You:




At your core, you are a passionate team player who appreciates and respects the viewpoints of your teammates.




 * More than 5 years of experience as a Product Owner, managing products from conception to launch and ongoing development.
 * Business acumen and B2B customer management experience with a strong focus on working with corporate customers.
 * Extensive experience in successfully delivering software projects and achieving high levels of customer satisfaction.
 * Experience with data-intensive solutions, i.e., those that convert raw information into actionable business insights.
 * Demonstrable principal knowledge of agile development and continuous delivery.
 * Knowledge of some agile frameworks such as Scrum.
 * Proficiency in using Atlassian Suite, including Confluence and Jira.
 * You know how to support your team and contribute conscientiously and passionately.
 * You embrace your role as a product ambassador and actively promote your product, including presenting at conferences.
 * You enjoy engaging in close communication with customers and users.
 * You thrive on overcoming challenges through your creativity.
 * You pay exceptional attention to detail.
 * You make data-driven decisions using relevant metrics.
 * You exhibit strong organizational skills and hold yourself to high-quality standards.
 * You are fluent in both German and English.




About us:




At MobiLab, we are committed to empowering our employees to bring their creative mindset into action, guiding our customers toward reaching their full data potential, and becoming Cloud-native organizations.

We are a diverse and dynamic team united by delivering engineering excellence. We are committed to inclusivity, where individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities, feel welcomed and valued. You will directly impact how future business works and contribute to industry-leading companies.

We are dedicated to growing our employees. Our company culture encourages knowledge sharing and learning with a dedicated MobiLab Career Development. Our headquarters, located in the heart of Cologne, offers a creative work environment. We provide a range of benefits, including a public transport ticket, access to industry conferences, a company pension scheme, and more.

If you’re passionate about Cloud Integration and striving for engineering perfection, we invite you to join our MobiLab Team. Let’s grow together!

title: Product Manager, Data & Analytics
description:
About Userlane

Userlane is a market-leading Digital Adoption Platform that empowers organisations to understand and improve the value of their technology investments. Working with some of the world's most recognisable enterprises, we identify and eliminate adoption barriers and produce a more engaging and productive software experience for employees.

Your mission

Own Application Intelligence At Userlane. You'll Shape What We Build Across App Discovery, HEART Analytics And Portfolio Overview To Help Enterprise CIOs And IT Leaders See Where Software Spending Delivers Value And Where It Creates Waste. You’ll Work On Opportunities Such As


 * Delivering outcome-linked metrics: Evolve our HEART Analytics to connect usage data to business outcomes like cost savings, efficiency and compliance risk that enterprise executives can take action on
 * Building for time-poor executives: Design analytics that bring insights to leaders and answers "what should I do?" not just "what happened?"
 * Scaling portfolio intelligence: Define how to connect engagement, cost and risk data across hundreds of applications, helping executives understand where value is created or lost in their software portfolio
 * Connecting fragmented data sources: Define the integration strategy to combine Userlane behavioural data with cost data from SAM tools, license data from IT asset management and employee data from HR systems
 * Transforming insights into action: Define what turns raw usage data into insights that drive action, not just dashboards people look at once
 * AI adoption governance: Extend analytics to measure how AI assistants and agents affect productivity, cost and ROI
   
   

Your profile


 * 3-5+ years of product management experience on data/analytics products within a modern product organisation
 * You've built analytics for executives or senior leaders - people who need insights pushed to them, not analysts who hunt for data. You understand the difference between interesting data and actionable insight
 * You start with the business question, not the data. Your first instinct is "what decision are they trying to make?" rather than "what data do we have?"
 * You have strong opinions on data visualisation for time-poor executives and a clear rationale for every data point you include in your solutions
 * You've worked in enterprise B2B (not B2C product analytics). Healthcare experience is a strong plus
 * You figure out what works by talking to customers and watching them use the product
 * You're capable of explaining things to engineers, salespeople, support agents and CEOs alike
 * You’re fluent in English (spoken and written)
   
   

What's in for you


 * Team & Culture: A high-performance culture with great leadership and a fun, engaged, motivated and diverse team with people from over 20 countries
 * Impact: You’ll be part of an empowered cross-functional team given the freedom and autonomy to solve real customer problems
 * Product strategy influence: Work directly with our VP Product to shape our 2026-2030 strategy as we expand into new sectors
 * Market: Userlane is among the global leaders in the rapidly growing Digital Adoption industry
 * Growth: We take you and your development seriously. You can expect weekly 121s, a personalised skills assessment and development plan, on-the-job coaching and budget for events and training

title: Product Manager Digital Health Studies
description:
Hi there!

Our goal at Data4Life is to make the world a healthier place. Our Product and Project Management team makes sure we move toward that goal with focus, rigor and speed - translating research ambition into products that generate real impact in healthcare, in Germany and beyond.

D4L Collect is our sensor data collection platform for digital health studies - one solution where researchers can simultaneously capture patient-reported and multimodal sensor data, from laboratory-grade devices to consumer wearables, and bring it all together as a unified, interoperable, GDPR-compliant dataset in FHIR. With a no-code study builder, paperless consent management, and a participant mobile app (Android and Apple), D4L Collect lets research teams set up and run their studies end-to-end while keeping full control of their data.

We're now investing in D4L Collect's next chapter - deepening it for clinical research (RWD studies, cohort studies, patient registries, RCTs), enriching it with validated patient-reported outcome instruments, clinician data entry, electronic data capture, richer EHR interoperability, and stronger regulatory rigor.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to help us grow the team and support that journey. You'll partner with the Lead Product Manager and Senior Project Manager and work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, product design, QA, BizDev, Comms, Scientific Team, and regulatory to make D4L Collect the platform of choice for digital health and real-world studies. The position is full-time, based in Berlin / Potsdam, with a permanent contract.

Your future role


 * Drive the next evolution of D4L Collect. Shape the roadmap for the platform's next chapter - a Patient Registry solution, electronic data capture platform, and a validated ePRO library.
 * Ship a regulatory-grade product, considering e.g. 21 CFR Part 11 audit trails and eConsent with e-signatures. Treat compliance as a design constraint to engineer around, not a tax.
 * Extend D4L Collect’s capture and connect functionality. Build on the platform's sensor, wearable, and patient-reported outcomes foundation by adding first-class support for new sensors (such as wearable devices, insulin pumps, and portable x-ray devices), by integrating EHR data via HL7 FHIR (including the International Patient Summary), and by extending the standard questionnaire library, including SDoH. Keep every data type research-ready and interoperable.
 * Make clinical trial standards possible through import (from REDCap and other commercial EDC/CTMS solutions) and export (to CDISC SDTM) into capabilities investigators, sponsors, and study sites can effectively use. Implement validation and certification of D4L Collect including ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and SOC 2 Type II
 * Be the user's advocate inside the team. Build and maintain deep relationships with the people who actually use D4L Collect - sites, investigators, study coordinators, clinicians, and most importantly patients and participants - making sure that those voices are heard in prioritization conversations.
   
   

What You Need To Succeed


 * 3+ years building a strong product craft foundation - discovery, roadmap, prioritization, and PRDs - in an agile environment.
 * 3+ years of progressive product management experience in B2B solutions or regulated digital health solutions, with 1+ years directly defining and shipping clinical research software - at least one of EDC, ePRO / eCOA, eConsent, patient registry, or sensor-based study platforms.
 * Hands-on experience shipping under GCP / ICH E6(R3), 21 CFR Part 11, and EU Annex 11, including computer system validation and audit-ready release management.
 * Working fluency in clinical data standards, especially CDISC (SDTM, CDASH) at a conceptual level, and a working understanding of HIPAA + GDPR as they apply to clinical trials and real-world data.
 * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, (Bio)medical Engineering, Health Informatics, Life Sciences, or equivalent practical experience.
 * Languages: You're fluent in English. German at B2 level and/or a third language is a plus.
   
   

Why you will love working with us


 * Nonprofit work with a clear purpose - Make the world a healthier place. At Data4Life, you'll find a meaningful role in a nonprofit environment with tangible impact on research and work on socially impactful projects in the healthcare sector, with renowned partners.
 * A diverse, international team of professionals working together across Potsdam, Berlin, and Singapore, and collaborating closely with partners with leading partners from research, technology, and healthcare such as at HPI·MS in New York and beyond.
 * Real work-life balance - flexible working hours, 30 days of paid vacation, and the option for mobile work.
 * Support for private healthcare and sustainable mobility.
 * Employee-driven initiatives, including our climate and DEI (diversity, equity & inclusion) groups.
   
   

Good to know


 * We especially welcome applicants from the LGBTQI+ community, people with a migration background, people of color, and individuals with disabilities or chronic illnesses to the team.
 * If you need support or special assistance during the application or interview process due to a disability, please let us know - we are happy to accommodate you as much as possible.
 * This position offers a permanent contract.
 * You will be based at our Potsdam / Berlin office.
   
   

Please send us your:


 * CV
 * Motivation letter
 * Reference letter(s)
 * Salary expectations and earliest possible starting date
   
   

About Us

Data4Life is a nonprofit organization with the vision of making the world a healthier place. With an international team, we work together on the mission to digitize health research. By linking technology and research, we make health data available to research in a comprehensive, digital and secure way. Our interdisciplinary team in Potsdam, Berlin and Singapore brings together experts from fields such as product development, digital engineering, data security and science. Data4Life was founded in 2017 and is funded by the Hasso Plattner Foundation.

We care about Diversity: Many different lives, careers, and development paths lead to Data4Life. We welcome experts from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to our international team, offering everyone equal opportunities to be themselves and develop to the best of their abilities. Diversity, equality, and inclusion are not just nice words at Data4Life – we put them into practice in all of our activities and projects, striving to incorporate them in our everyday lives. For this reason, we signed the Charta der Vielfalt (Diversity Charter) in 2022.

title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
description:
IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention. Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability.

The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France, and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries.

This position is based in Munich, Germany.

We’re recruiting a Product Manager to drive our automated identity verification solution, delivering compliance, security, and performance.

Key Responsibilities

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager / Product Owner to own the end-to-end product lifecycle: capture market and customer needs, shape strategy and roadmap, and drive delivery with engineering. You will advise sales and customer‑facing teams and work directly with customers on product setup and solution patterns. The immediate priority is supporting customer migrations to a new platform driven by regulatory change; the role will broaden to encompass additional capabilities on the new platform over time. You will collaborate closely with Product & Technology Leadership and Sales Leadership across DACH and other markets. IDnow provides GenAI-enabled tooling and expects responsible, compliant use.


 * Business outcome ownership: define measurable goals and KPIs (adoption, quality, satisfaction) and drive outcome-oriented delivery.
 * Roadmapping: maintain an outcome-focused roadmap that converts market, regulatory and customer insights into prioritized initiatives; align with leadership and sales.
 * Delivery & specification: translate roadmap items into epics, user stories and testable acceptance criteria; lead backlog refinement, sprint planning and reviews; make trade‑offs on scope, quality and timelines; coordinate release readiness and enablement.
 * Incident triage & quality: rapidly triage issues, gather context, coordinate fixes, run post-incident reviews and capture preventive actions in the backlog; communicate status to customer-facing teams and customers.
 * Migration support: help define pragmatic migration plans, cutover guidance, deprecation strategies and customer enablement materials; track adoption and surface risks.
 * Customer engagement: join customer meetings with Sales and Customer Success to validate value propositions via interviews, prototypes and pilots.
 * GenAI-‑enabled ways of working: use GenAI to accelerate discovery, specification, incident summaries and reporting—ensuring human oversight and compliance.
   
   

Preferred Experience


 * Degree in Business, Computer Science or related field.
 * 3 years in product roles with end-to-end ownership.
 * Proven customer facing experience.
 * Technical fluency (APIs/architecture).
 * Agile proficiency (Jira/Confluence).
 * Practical, responsible use of GenAI
 * Experience with Enterprise customer migration is preferable
 * German and English
   
   

Perks & Benefits

 * We value personal and professional development: make full use of Udemy, our training platform with 24/7 access and unlimited content/course consumption incl. certification.

IDnow applies the principles of non-discrimination and equality: We strive to establish, maintain, and promote an open and inclusive recruitment process and working environment by respecting the principles of equal opportunities. Including but not limited to: sex, race or ethnic origin, religion or convictions, gender identity, citizenship, marital status, disability, age, or sexual orientation.

title: Product Designer: AI & Complex Flows
description:
Most AI products are built by people who understand the technology. What they often miss is the human on the other side of the screen, confused, rushed, sometimes anxious, trying to make a decision that matters.

This role is about bridging that gap. You will design interfaces where AI genuinely helps people: not by doing more, but by doing the right thing at the right moment. You will use AI tools in your own process — to prototype faster, test smarter, and iterate with intent.

We are looking for someone who is thoughtful, curious, and experienced, and who sees inclusive design not as a constraint but as a foundation.

What You Will Work On


 * AI-assisted user flows: Design interfaces that surface machine learning outputs — recommendations, flags, automated decisions — in ways that feel clear and trustworthy, not overwhelming or opaque.
 * Complex multi-step flows: Own end-to-end journeys with many moving parts: onboarding, verification, financial decisions, settings. Map the full picture before you design any single screen.
 * Rapid AI-powered prototyping: Use tools like Figma AI, Galileo, Uizard, Framer, or similar to move from idea to testable prototype quickly. Know when a lo-fi sketch is enough and when a high-fidelity prototype earns its weight.
 * A/B testing and experimentation: Design variants with clear hypotheses. Work with product and data to interpret results. Let evidence guide your next iteration — not assumptions.
 * Conversational and voice UX: Design for chat-based and voice entry points where structure, language, and flow clarity matter more than visual polish.
 * Accessible and inclusive design: Build for users across geographies, languages, literacy levels, and abilities. Accessibility is structural here — not a final audit.
 * Design system contribution: Create and maintain components that scale without fragmenting. Your work should make the next designer's job easier.
   
   

What We Are Looking For

We care more about how you think and what you have shipped than about where you studied or how many years are on your CV. Here is what matters to us:


 * Hands-on experience with AI in your design process. You use AI tools actively to prototype, generate layout variants, write microcopy drafts, or speed up research synthesis. You can name the tools and explain when they helped and when they got in the way.
 * Experience designing complex user flows. You have mapped and designed multi-step journeys that involved edge cases, error states, branching logic, and real user needs. You understand that a flow is only as strong as its weakest moment.
 * A/B testing experience with real outcomes. You have designed experiments, not just handed off screens. You have seen results, updated your assumptions, and made better decisions because of it.
 * Data-informed decision making. You use quantitative signals such as drop-off rates, conversion data, task completion, alongside qualitative research. You can show work where data changed what you built.
 * Inclusive design as a practice, not a principle. You have made specific decisions to serve users with different abilities, contexts, or literacy levels. You can talk about what you chose and why.
 * Figma fluency. Component architecture, auto layout, variables, and design tokens at a level that makes engineer handoff smooth.
   
   

What This Role Is Not


 * Not a pixel-pushing role. Visual craft matters, but it follows research and interaction decisions.
 * Not an agency model. You own outcomes, behaviour change, task success, reduced drop-off, not deliverables.
 * Not a role where AI replaces your thinking. You use AI tools to move faster and test more, your judgment still leads.
   
   

How Applications Are Assessed

I want to be transparent about this before you invest your time.

Every application is reviewed by a human (me). I am looking for evidence of the things listed above, not keywords. A portfolio without at least one end-to-end case study will not move forward. A case study that shows your specific contribution, the trade-offs you navigated, and what you measured will stand out.

All applications are compared before anyone is advanced. If more than 15 candidates meet the criteria, I rank by depth of AI tools experience, quality of flow documentation, and strength of experimentation examples.

You will hear back from us regardless of outcome. That is a commitment, not a courtesy.

This role is open only to EU-based candidates.

Hubert Warszta

title: Head of Product Management (m/f/d)
description:
WELCOME TO BASF

In the Performance Chemicals Division, it is all about customized products. The division's portfolio includes plastics additives, fuel and lubricant solutions as well as oilfield chemicals, mining solutions and chemical as well as refinery catalysts. The customers who benefit from our innovative solutions are from various industries, including the chemicals, plastics, consumer goods, energy and resources as well as the automotive and transportation industries.


What You Can Expect

In our Global Product Management unit, we actively shape the strategic direction of our global product portfolio in the Performance Chemicals business. Together with international partners along the entire value chain, we drive innovation, profitability, and sustainable growth.


 * In your new role, you lead the global team for the Strategic Business Unit Light Stabilizers and are responsible for global price management by reviewing supply and demand, deriving pricing guidelines and global limits, and ensuring positive margins, high asset utilization, and profitable volume and value growth in line with budget and long-term strategy with full global P&L responsibility.
 * You optimize global supply and production costs by managing asset utilization and inventories, allocating volumes in shortage or force majeure situations, and further developing global make-or-buy, co-manufacturing, tolling, product and production strategies.
 * Furthermore, you analyze and steer the product portfolio by initiating positioning and optimization measures, driving portfolio development, identifying market trends, closing portfolio gaps, and supporting innovation and product development projects through to market launch.
 * Additionally you develop, implement and monitor product and main group strategies in line with the global SBU strategy and initiate corrective actions where necessary. You initiate restructuring and investment projects and support strategic initiatives through sound commercial evaluations.
 * Last but not least, you drive all portfolio-related topics cross-functionally into the regional organizations and ensure close alignment with Supply Chain, Marketing, IPM, PS&R as well as other interfaces.
   
   
   


What You Offer


 * completed master’s degree in chemistry, materials science, business administration or a related field
 * at least ten years of professional experience, ideally across various functions such as marketing, sales, product management, R&D, production or controlling

How To Reach Us

About Us

BASF Lampertheim GmbH, a subsidiary of BASF SE located in the middle of the Rhine-Neckar-Triangle, produces and distributes specialty chemicals for our parent company as well as chemical companies, automotive suppliers and plastics producers.
